notes: HARD = penetration > 0.5"; contact up to 0.5" ignored; CLEARANCE = duct/equipment within 1" of structure without touching: minor below 0.75" (0.25" positional precision), info from 0.75" to 1".

Penetration = exact SAT push-out depth of the deepest convex piece pair; a horizontal duct whose run passes through a horizontal member reports the vertical overlap at the crossing when that is larger (piece breaks inside a member). Clearance gap = widest separating-axis gap, a lower bound of the true distance (may over-report at skew corners).
Contact point is approximate: centre of the two pieces' AABB intersection, moved to the middle of the overlap along the minimum-penetration axis.

Profiles follow bimlib/mesh.py (channel web and angle leg on -width, double channels back to back); round = inscribed 12-gon, exact at top/bottom/sides; HSS tubes are treated as filled. Non-convex wall / glazing meshes are split into convex pieces along their extrusion (no hull fill).
Ceiling/soffit test: MEP piece bottom (lowest vertex) vs ceiling underside over the plan overlap; MEP topping out more than 4 ft below a ceiling is treated as another level.

Ceilings applied to the deck/framing (ACT-3 deck panels, GYP-2 1HR) have no plenum: MEP below them is exposed by design and only a real overlap counts. A drop through a rated ceiling = Rated ceiling penetration (major); through a non-rated ceiling = no clash. Clearance (<1") is not reported for MEP whose elevation is assumed.

Intended: riser through roof/deck/roof well = info (opening required); duct or pipe through a non-rated wall or glazing = info; curb on roof, equipment on its curb, air terminal in ceiling/wall, wall-mounted unit on its wall, curb bearing on a member = none.

Wall / glazing penetrations count only where the duct run passes through the wall (past one face and to within 0.5" of the other across its local thickness); a duct alongside a face or ending inside the wall, up to 6" into it, is position tolerance (not reported, counted below). Pairs of one MEP element, run or touching chain against adjacent wall pieces (split headers, jambs of a door gap) = one opening.

Tolerance rules: a riser up to 2.5" into the framing of its own roof opening = minor opening fit; an assumed air terminal up to 4" onto a member face = minor (verify); assumed-elevation MEP up to 1" into the member it hangs under = not reported (counted below); duct pieces under 2" wide = skipped.

Resolutions are rule-based: drops/shifts are the exact moves that clear that element, plus 1"; a drop is never proposed below the MEP's ceiling (+3" assembly) or an ARC ceiling under it, and a terminal slide is re-tested against every structural member along its run.
Grid offsets: + = east of a letter grid / north of a number grid (project north).

Trade matrix: HVAC is tested against structure, architecture, plumbing, fire protection, electrical, technology and pool. Against the other trades a hard overlap > 0.5" is major (critical stays HVAC x steel); clearance (< 1") is reported only for HVAC vs pipe / tray / conduit / busway runs whose elevations are not assumed; sprinkler heads, light fixtures, devices and fixtures count only when they overlap (a duct above a recessed fixture is no clash); items attached to the unit they serve (disconnects, J-boxes, conduit naming its tag, duct smoke detectors on ducts, drain pipes at floor drains) and two wall-mounted items on one wall face (<= 1") are not reported (counted below).

Not reported (tolerance rules, raw pairs): wall-mounted unit on its own wall (<= 1"): 4; curb base bearing on the top of a horizontal member (<= 1"): 3; assumed-elevation MEP hung tight under a horizontal member, <= 1" into it: 0; riser within 1" of the framing at its roof opening (opening fit): 17; duct/pipe alongside a wall face or ending in a wall, not through it, <= 6" into it: 46; trade item attached to the HVAC element it serves (disconnect / J-box / conduit naming the unit, duct smoke detector on a duct, HVAC drain pipe at a floor drain): 0; two wall-mounted items on one wall face, <= 1": 0
